0.original: One cannot excavate on an empty stomach, as Qhoterl Pasol well knows.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

1.original: Deliver the requested items to Qhoterl Pasol.

48.original: Digging is whisker-warping work, as I'm sure you will agree. If one is to keep at it day in and day out, one must have good, nourishing meals.

49.original: If you're willing, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, might I trouble you to bring some ingredients so that I can prepare a hearty meal for everyone? My Chaqurl, in particular, is still a growing boy, and few things please me more than to see his belly full and round.

50.original: For the dish I plan to make, I still require three ant eggs. If you search in the vicinity of Mjrl's Regret, you should be able to dig them up readily enough.

51.original: For the dish I plan to make, I still require three silkworms. If you search in the vicinity of Mjrl's Regret, you should be able to gather them readily enough.

52.original: For the dish I plan to make, I still require a robber crab. If you fish at the Lozatl using fruit worms, I daresay they'll bite readily enough.

53.original: Three ant eggs ought to suffice for the dish I plan to make. If you search in the vicinity of Mjrl's Regret, you should be able to dig them up readily enough.

54.original: Three silkworms ought to suffice for the dish I plan to make. If you search in the vicinity of Mjrl's Regret, you should be able to gather them readily enough.

55.original: One robber crab ought to suffice for the dish I plan to make. If you fish at the Lozatl using fruit worms as bait, I daresay they'll bite readily enough.

56.original: How fares the procuring effort, good <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>?

57.original: Ah, splendid! I shall stew these eggs with spices and serve them with cornbread.

58.original: A delectable combination, as my Chaqurl will attest. He doesn't leave so much as a single crumb behind!

59.original: Ah, splendid! Plump and fresh as they are, these silkworms are best prepared simply─fried and salted.

60.original: If there's a way to my husband's stomach, I can say with confidence that this dish is it. The shine in his eyes doesn't lie!

61.original: Ah, splendid! I shall boil this crab whole with vegetables and serve it with steamed grains!

62.original: I'm not too proud to admit that this is my personal favorite. Ah, the mere thought of it makes my mouth water... <slurp>

63.original: Without further ado, I shall set about preparing the meal. We are all in for a treat, and it is thanks to you, good <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>!
